items.title: Example: regional foreign-exchange market monitoring update
items.content:
This is a fictional source article used only to demonstrate the API contract. It is not a real news report, a market forecast, or investment advice. No real institution, policy announcement, price, or trading event is represented by this example.

A production sender replaces this field with the verified text of the linked source article. It preserves the original paragraphs and source language while removing navigation, advertising, cookie notices, and unrelated recommendations. The full status is used only when the complete article body has actually been obtained and has not been truncated.

This final paragraph closes the fictional example article. Production summaries are supplied separately and must never be copied into the content field to pretend that the original article has been retrieved.
items.summary: A fictional article demonstrating how verified source text, a separate summary, and an original website link are transmitted together.
